editorial.description: A compact tutorial pairs an honest conversation with an artist from Choe's old podcast with an ASMR-like bamboo drawing, asking what must be said plainly and who occupies the viewer's imagined forest.
editorial.summary: A compact tutorial pairs an honest conversation with an artist from Choe's old podcast with an ASMR-like bamboo drawing, asking what must be said plainly and who occupies the viewer's imagined forest. This is an official-channel creative lesson or reflection, not clinical treatment or a universal formula. Its chronological map follows the route's own transcript and distinguishes art-making instructions from autobiographical claims, jokes and metaphors. Visually dependent technique still requires the source video.

connections.note: The route uses a studio art process to organize autobiographical reflection; metaphor is part of the exercise and is not medical advice.
The video treats revision, imperfection and emotional attention as more important than copying a polished Choe image.

publication_restrictions.rule: Do not present mental-health, addiction or trauma metaphors as diagnosis or treatment; preserve them as the artist’s framing.
